title: My Lawyer Is Not So Easy

overview: Hajime Madoka, a police officer of the Special Accounts Unit, has been dispatched from headquarters with a special mission to cut costs at local police stations as part of fiscal austerity. She monitors detectives' investigation expenses and suggests cost cutting plans. As she is the meticulous sort, she cannot stop thinking about a discrepancy once she spots it. She is also extraordinarily strong in numbers. Madoka was raised by her grandmother who loves detective dramas and she became a police officer because she wanted to be like the detectives she admired. However, she was born extremely unlucky and called a jinx because she gets the people around her into trouble. She was not assigned to the Criminal Affairs Division as she had hoped and ended up doing office work. Madoka sees cases from the money aspect, noticing anything odd or clues that detectives on the scene may miss to solve cases in her own unique way.
title: Tokumei! Keishicho Tokubetsu Kaikeigakari

overview: The high school classmates reunited again because a model couple hosted a "death wedding banquet", which shocked all the classmates. Thirty years after graduation, everyone is already forty-eight years old, and it is considered that two-thirds of their lives have passed. If there is still another chance to fall in love, how many people will risk their lives to pursue the last light of life?
title: Hun Yin Jie Ye Shi

overview: The story of the Great Russian empress in her early years (15-33). Prepare to become a witness of the first 20 years (1744–1762) of her life in Russia. 20 years of court intrigues, conspiracies, power struggles and unconditional love to Russia.
title: Великая

overview: The story of the legendary poet in Emperor Krishnadevaraya's court who uses his timely wit and intelligence to solve even the trickiest problems and becomes very popular in the King's court.
title: Tenali Rama

overview: Lord Krishna, once a naughty little child, grows up and embarks on a number of adventures to fight and eradicate evil forces and provide justice to all.
title: Jai Shree Krishna

overview: Christmas is approaching in the small community of Västerköping. Priest Björn longs for the south, Tom longs for Santa and Terese in the cash register longs for Christmas to be over.
title: Trevlig julhelg!

overview: The incredible true story of the brave crewmen who survived a shipwreck, only to face an even more terrifying peril. After delivering components for the atomic bomb that will bring WWII to an end, a mighty naval cruiser is torpedoed, leaving 900 men in the middle of nowhere. With the men clinging to floating debris and one another, and with the U.S. Navy unaware of their distress, ravenous sharks move in for the kill.
title: Shark Terror: USS Indianapolis

overview: Using his trademark wit, host Graham Norton will oversee the 10 comedic stars, brought together to make each other laugh by using every unpredictable comedic tool in the box … without cracking a smile themselves. With the added bonus of some celebrity cameos, their performances will have viewers - but hopefully not their fellow stars - laughing out loud. As the clock counts down and the tension rises, whoever can outlast their competitors will be crowned the first winner of LOL: Last One Laughing Ireland and win a grand prize of €50,000 for their charity of choice.
title: LOL: Last One Laughing Ireland

overview: The lives of the carelessly incompetent medical team at a hospital in the Parisian suburbs explode in surreal humour as they go about their daily duties.
title: H

overview: The play tells the story of Zhen Gaogui, a "bankrupt and down-to-earth lady" who was forced to work as a part-time worker in a public relations company due to financial difficulties, and sparked a collision with Zhong Yiming, the "Wind Dog's acting CEO of Party A", a noble lady who returned from studying abroad and found herself bankrupt, and the second young master who was entrusted with a heavy responsibility while doing nothing, experienced thrilling and prosperous times together, and the two teamed up to turn "little popcorn" into a "big business." In the process, the two people gradually fell in love, and the revolutionary friendship was perfectly sublimated. Zhong Zhen Buchu's CP also gained growth and opened up his heart. He told the audience about the sweet growth of a workplace novice who was hilariously abused online and resented each other's enemies. story, creating a workplace love comedy with two-way healing between the male and female protagonists.
title: Amazing Girls

overview: Targeted assassinations, bombings, unidentified military attacks are piling up all over the Middle East. Can the "secret war" between Iran and Israel turn into a major regional if not global confrontation? The two countries are nowadays the two dominant powers in the Middle East. Their conflict is reinforced by the renewed tension between the United States and Iran since President Trump decided to leave the nuclear agreement. Based on unprecedented archival research, access to high profile players in Israel, Iran, Lebanon and the US, the film looks back over the forty years that followed the Islamic revolution in Iran, the Israeli invasion of Lebanon, the Civil war in Syria, to offer relevant keys to understanding the new Middle East.
title: La Longue Guerre : Israël - Iran - USA

overview: They say the first year of marriage is the hardest. Newlyweds, Tayler and Jason, want to put this cultural idea to the test on a 12,000-mile exploration across the United States to climb three of America's most prominent peaks. As they uncover all that awaits for them on the road, they also uncover more about each other.
title: Love on the Rocks

overview: Perpetually disturbed by the world around them, two friends navigate their lives as outliers in Toronto's queer community.
title: I Hate People, People Hate Me

overview: The Game Show explores the often overlooked but always delicious possibilities found in the cooking of wild game. Pro chef and butcher Elias Cairo, of Portland Oregon's Olympia Provisions, shares his insights and expertise with approachable recipes in an easy-to-digest format. Each episode brings a new recipe with tips on butchery, seasoning, and the time-honored experience of outdoor cooking.
title: The Game Show

overview: An accidental first kiss sparks the rest of everything… Achivich has secretly harbored strong feelings for Jirawat since high school, when he was pursuing his affections for a girl who later cheats on him. The turning point of this best friends story begins after a movie night that turns into an unexpected, tender romantic moment between the two. Achivich is heartbroken when Jirawat wants to forget everything that happened that night. Ten years passed, the former best friends return – Jirawat, now a gentle but insecure Orthopedic surgeon, and Achivich a famous superstar. They meet again and their bond grows stronger as they get to know each other. Will they be able to "continue" where they left off, that night at the movies?
title: To Be Continued

overview: The Pombo is one of the most influential families of content creators in Spain. Its growth in networks is unstoppable. The products they promote sell out in a matter of hours. The Pombo are handsome, young, fun. And, as they describe themselves, the Pombos are "a very normal family."
title: Pombo

overview: Fingermouse is a British children's television programme created by Michael Cole for the BBC in 1985. It is a spin-off of the earlier series Fingerbobs. The first episode was broadcast on 4 November 1985 on BBC1. The eponymous star was a paper finger puppet in the form of a mouse, who would play various musical instruments with the help of Iain Lauchlan, called the Music Man. Fingermouse also went adventuring outside, interacting with other paper puppets made by artist Joanne Cole. Each episode lasted fifteen minutes, and one series of 13 episodes was made.
title: Fingermouse

overview: Three mothers in their 30s, 40s, and 50s cross paths with Torako. One is a working mom who is worried sick about her child's future. Another became a second wife and entered the upper echelon of society whose net worth is in the top 3%, but feels she doesn't belong. The third is a despondent divorced mother working at her parents' restaurant. Although there is a huge difference in their standard of living, the three women long for the same thing—for their child to get into their dream school.
title: Katei kyoushi no torako

overview: Yohei Ueshima is a so-called "Hikikomori Survivor", who had been isolated for 11 years since he was 38. He finally escaped from his room three years ago. After the escape, he opened a yakitori restaurant with the help of the local residents, but he could not talk to customers properly and was still in the process of reintegrating into the society. One day he was hired as a part-time teacher at a municipal junior high school. While struggling with various problems around him, he receives support from his withdrawal friends and supporters.
title: Hikikomori Sensei

overview: In an anonymous mountain town, 17-year-old Maria, a high school senior, dreams of becoming a dancer. Her daydreams stop when she becomes pregnant by her boyfriend, Tassos, a young man who has spent his whole life working in the only gas station in the city. Until Joe appears in her life - a boy who stands out from the conservative environment of the local community. The two of them, together, will embark on a journey full of adventures and emotions that will bring Maria faced with the biggest dilemma: to do what everyone expects from her or to turn everything upside down?
title: Milky Way

overview: The story of a group of friends from high school. They reconnected on Hangout night and spent the evening sharing stories of love, relationships, and life after marriage.
title: Plueak Rak Pom Luang

overview: Together with his helper, Petter Northug, Oslolosen has gathered ten well-known Norwegians to see if they are really good enough. They get to sharpen their skills at historically rooted competitions with a twist, designed by Oslolosen. Who is willing to sacrifice the kneecap or break the tip of the nose to stand on the podium in the end?
title: Vinnerschkalle

overview: Before Ekichi Onizuka would become "Great Teacher Onizuka", he and Ryuji Danma were members of the infamous biker gang Oni-Baku.
title: Shonan Junai Gumi

overview: Bar Rescue follows Jon Taffer, one of the country's top restaurant and bar consultants, will give failing establishments one last chance to succeed. The show will delve into every business facet of running a bar from creating a profitable drink/food menu to crowd management to music selection to managing disgruntled employees. This marks the first food/beverage-themed show for Spike TV, furthering its effort to expand and broaden its audience.
title: Bar Rescue

overview: A hunter and a cook, hunt some special animals for later to cook and eat it
title: Nak Og Æd

overview: Secrets of Polygamy delves into the worlds of extreme polygamist groups and explores how the power held by Prophet Warren Jeffs, who is currently serving a life sentence for his crimes committed as Prophet, and other high-profile polygamists, such as Sam Bateman, have shaped communities where claims of abuse, incest and fraud have become common. Investigator Matt Browning, retired law enforcement, meets with former members who have escaped to hear shocking allegations of mental and physical abuse suffered by polygamist women and children. The series features in-depth interviews with experts and access to insiders including Warren Jeffs' daughter, Rachel Jeffs Blackmore, who shares her first-hand account of life with her father, one of Jeffs' former wives, Alyshia Blackmore, former members Mary Ann Kingston, Lu Ann Cooper and Faith Bistline, investigators Shelly Livingstone and Terry Jacklin and others. Additionally, never-before-seen photos from Alyshia and Warren's wedding and audio from Jeffs' and Bateman's teachings help shine a light on these groups and offer a definitive look at polygamy in America.
title: Secrets of Polygamy

overview: Women of the Earth is a documentary series capturing the resilient work of female land stewards across the United States. The subjects in this series represent a diverse group of women, whose work continues to lead our world towards effective and reciprocal solutions to systematically change the way we approach climate healing.
title: Women of the Earth

overview: Would you hand over your unlocked phone to your mum, dad, or family member? Dave's new digital exclusive Get Off My Phone! puts comedians and their chaotic group chats, unexplainable photos, and weirdest DMs under the scrutiny of their real family members. Nothing is off limits as embarrassing videos, cheeky texts, mortifying search history and more secrets are revealed for the internet to see.
title: Get Off My Phone!

overview: Journalist Sagar's life turns thrilling as he unravels dark secrets behind newspaper clippings predicting tragedies. He becomes a murder suspect, racing against time to clear his name and solve the enigma and faces dangerous twists. Suspense builds in this roller-coaster ride.
title: Dhootha

overview: A man who, against his will, goes back to his hometown, where he is forced to face his history and prove his innocence.
title: Shehar Lakhot

overview: Dmitry Pozov and Sergey Gorokh compete with a professional chef and recipes from the Internet. The guest decides who wins!
title: Кулинарка

overview: Mehdi Hasan provides insightful reporting and probing interviews that examine the day's events and provide a deeper level of context for the politics of our interconnected society.
title: The Mehdi Hasan Show

overview: Alicia Menendez focuses on raising voices that aren't typically featured on cable news.
title: American Voices with Alicia Menendez

overview: Three Inches is an American action with science fiction made-for-television film, intended to serve as the pilot episode for a new series. Created by writer-producer Harley Peyton and directed by Jace Alexander it aired on Syfy on December 29, 2011. The show follows a group of people with superhuman abilities, focusing on Walter Spackman, played by Noah Reid, an underachiever who develops a telekinetic ability after being struck by lightning. The movie received favourable reviews, however, it failed to become a TV series.
title: Three Inches

overview: Ali and his friend Morteza, two naturally gifted but unemployed thespians, exert their acting talents in unique ways to earn a living. Hopping from one staged marriage proposal to one university acceptance celebration, they perform at wealthy people's functions to surprise their guests and in the hope of finding their way back to a proper theatre stage. But surprises can sometimes turn awry, and soon enough Ali and Morteza catch the attention of a mysterious agency…
title: آکتور

overview: Fresh analysis of the week's biggest events and a rotating crew of major D.C. newsmakers.
title: The Weekend

overview: Hosted by TV and radio presenter Roman Kemp, this unmissable TV event sees a number of groups comprised of stars from TV's biggest shows go head-to-head in a spectacular sing-off.
title: Britain Get Singing

overview: Sanju finds a magical pencil, which has the power to bring anything he draws to life. While Fun at first, the pencil opens more mystical adventures.
title: Shaka Laka Boom Boom

overview: 6 part series showing different dinosaurs in each continent.
title: When Dinosaurs Ruled

overview: When we talk about sex, we mean business and business is booming. Join Weezy WTF as she explores sex-related businesses, while helping solve a celebrity guest's sexual issues - whether they know they have them or not.
title: Sex Sells

overview: Catch up from the castle. The latest banished and murdered have their say with Ed Gamble. How will they react to the betrayals, revelations, mind games and manipulations?
title: The Traitors: Uncloaked

overview: Discover the challenges and espionage behind the race to build the first supersonic airliner.
title: Concorde: The Untold Story

overview: Rajeev Bansal, a simpleton, leads a content life with his loving family. However, he wishes to build a rapport with and become a close confidant and friend to his young son.
title: Tera Yaar Hoon Main

overview: The new Oxford English Dictionary officially defines a ‘ladette' as: "young women who behave in a boisterously assertive or crude manner and engage in heavy drinking sessions." Are modern young women as uncouth as the media portray them, or does old fashioned style, elegance and class still have a place in their world? In These girls put the pig in Pygmalion, but Ladette to Lady attempts to turn these loud-mouthed ladettes back into ladies in a boot camp of etiquette, manners and social graces. Taking a real life finishing school curriculum - beefed up for the modern world - we'll find out if modern young women are as uncouth as the media portray them to be, or if they can still epitomise English style and class? In this rip-roaring yet revealing factual entertainment series, the ladettes will be given two months of intensive training before they have to face a final...
title: Ladette to Lady

overview: Punn, a young antique shop owner, is enlisted by his close friend to restore a painting. During the process, Punn accidentally cuts himself on a shard of mirror, staining the artwork with his blood. This act awakens Ramil, the last descendant of a vampire lineage, who has been trapped within the painting for over a century. However, Ramil emerges powerless and becomes the target of relentless pursuit by the "Hunters." Tasked with helping Ramil reclaim his lost powers, Punn embarks on a journey to locate Ramil's former servants. Along the way, a bond gradually forms between the two of them. How will the journey of Punn, Ramil, and the Hunters on the move unfold? Will romance between humans and vampires be possible?
title: Revamp The Undead Story

overview: The world's best surfers are paired together to travel the globe looking for pinnacle surfing experiences. Each experiences their commonality and creates connections to the places they explore, searching for the world's best breaks.
title: A Life in Proximity

overview: Kicking off their journey in three distinct areas of Wyoming, the three two-person teams of Bronco Ambassadors embark on their journey. Micayla & Tyrhee fly fish the Ham's Fork, Lael & Andrew climb Fremont Canyon, Kayla & Aaron bike the Bighorn, and visit the National Forest Foundation.
title: Wildly Wyoming

overview: Vlad & Niki is the global preschool phenomenon and highest rated kids channel starring the imaginative personalities and antics of brothers Vlad and Niki, who are showcased in non-stop fun and crazy adventures.
title: Vlad & Niki

overview: Take in the sights and sounds of Italy from the sky and learn about Europe's boot from heel to toe.
title: Aerial Italy

overview: The Madison is a heartfelt study of grief and human connection following a New York City family in the Madison River valley of central Montana. It is a profound love story channeled through a deeply personal family drama about resilience and transformation. The Madison is unfolding across two distinct worlds - the beautiful landscape of Montana and the vibrant energy of Manhattan - as it examines the ties that bind families together.
title: The Madison

overview: "Only Human" is a documentary shown on ITV in the UK giving an insight into daily lives of people with various disabilities and special needs, as well as various other illnesses such as cancer and weight issues.
title: Only Human

overview: From a Celtic queen to foul mouthed avant-garde actors, Tony meets the rebels whose fights for justice changed the course of history, and uncovers some spooky coincidences when he explores the twists of fate that have shaped our world.
title: Tony Robinson's Time Travels

overview: Tony Robinson examines historical myths, legends and mysteries to sort out which are fact and which are fiction.
title: Fact or Fiction

overview: In this series Tony Robinson explores the true story of the factory workers whose blood, sweat and toil forged the Industrial Revolution. He finds out how they rose up to launch a wave of social change that laid the foundation for the country we know today. His investigation focuses on Quarry Bank Mill in Cheshire – the inspiration for Channel 4s drama series The Mill. Quarry Banks buildings and machinery are remarkably well preserved and its original records from the 19th century are almost entirely intact. Together, these unique resources reveal the stories of the men, women and children who toiled in the mill.
title: The Real Mill with Tony Robinson

overview: Famed British presenter Tony Robinson delves into the turbulent lives of a few of history's most dynamic leaders. The series explores the brilliant reforms, brutal conflicts, the grand successes and failures of global leaders such as England's Richard III or the Roman Emperors Julius Caesar, Caligula and Nero. It digs into other famous wielders of power such as Robin Hood and William Wallace.
title: Legends of Power with Tony Robinson

overview: In this series Sir Tony Robinson, the history presenter and former Black Adder star, tells the story of the Great War. How it started, how it changed the world and how it finished with a 100 day flourish of military brilliance, which finally put an end to four years of incompetence and slaughter. With the aid of hundreds of amazing archived 3D images of the Great War which chronicle WW1 from start to finish and breathe new life into the story, Tony Robinson's World War 1 allows modern audiences to see the war in a completely new way. Robinson will also show how the Great War changed British people for generations to come - liberating large portions of the working class, powering the rise of the Labour party and breaking the old ties of service to the aristocracy. The series will begin with Robinson visiting a Berlin Kaiserpanorama show, where he will explain the stereoscope 3D process and uses it to show Europe (in 3D) before the war - a cultured and beautiful lost world.
title: Tony Robinson's World War One

overview: Two teams of comedians compete to come up with the best punchlines based on the day's news.
title: Punchline

overview: It will transport the very close-knit and entertaining band of protagonists to the 1970s, between the environments of the youthful left and those of the subversive right of the Borghese Coup.
title: Non ci resta che il crimine

overview: The Bogan Hunters! An Australia wide hunt for our greatest bogans in their natural habitat.
title: Bogan Hunters

overview: "Good Morning Amerca" anchors Josh Elliott and Lara Spencer helm the morning staple's hourlong afternoon extension. The show features reporting on pop culture, entertainment, lifestyle, health, workplace and consumer reporting by contributors from the ABC News family. In addition, the hosts welcome celebrity guests and performances by popular musicians.
title: Good Afternoon America

overview: In 2019, A group of teenagers aiming to overthrow the old ‘FIAT' financial world with their cryptocurrency.
title: Coin Digger

overview: Songkran is a real estate mogul a total womanizer with a son named Pe. But he didn't start out like this, though. Pe's mother left him when he was young to be with another man. Kran was heartbroken and began treating women like toys and gained the nickname 'Invincible Casanova' along with his best friend Sia Ou who runs a modelling agency. Ingdao and her family own a large orange farm. She's the type that takes no crap from anyone. Thanks to her huge mole and unkempt appearance she is often viewed as ugly. Nevertheless, she has a boyfriend named Nu, a dashing and mild-mannered teacher from the same town.
title: คู่แค้นแสนรัก

overview: The protagonist Anton makes a bet with the rector of the university that he will "raise" any Ukrainian village and make something like "Silicon Valley" out of it. Actually, the rector grasps these words and offers the guy to change the village of Antonovka in six months. Together with Anton, his friends - math genius Bogdan and blogger Milana - are going on the trip.
title: Голова

overview: Catch the UK's best LGBTQ+ stand up comedians performing live in the UK's first queer comedy club.
title: Live at the Queer Comedy Club

overview: Four of LA's hottest gay adult stars deal with explosive drama, careers, and friendship.
title: X-Rated: LA

overview: Joseph Shepherd interviews Drag Queens with a controversial past on the hit show "RuPauls Drag Race"
title: Exposed with Joseph Shepherd

overview: Find Me a Māori Bride follows the comic misadventures of Tama Bradley, and his cousin George Alpert, a pair of successful, metrosexual Māori men, whose lives are turned upside down, when presented with a wero (challenge), by their late grandmother – find a Māori wife within 6 months, or lose out on inheriting the whānau farm, worth a whopping $47,000,000.
title: Find Me a Māori Bride

overview: When a young woman, living the seemingly perfect life with the perfect relationship, is confronted with the fact that she fakes every single orgasm, a desperate search for release in all aspects of her life begins.
title: Killjoy

overview: Forty years ago, the discovery of a baby's remains on a beach in County Kerry set off a series of shocking twists - retold in this engrossing tale blurring innocence and guilt.
title: Murdered: The Baby on the Beach

overview: Katya works in a porcelain store, she is lonely and in love with the owner, entrepreneur Oleg. His fiancée Milena and Katya's school friend Victor, who has his own plans for Katya, don't like this at all. One day there is a major theft in a store, for which Katya is accused, she has to pay the shortfall. Victor offers his help - he is in love and is sure that he has his own rights to Katya. Being in a hopeless situation, Katya agrees to accept Victor's help, not imagining how this could turn out...
title: Фарфоровое счастье

overview: Sveta is the owner of a small bakery, she is raising her son Vanka alone, her main concern is the happiness of her son, who waits for his father every day. And Roman lives his own life: he meets with the daughter of a major official, Yulia, and works in the local administration. Gradually, the relationship between father and son improves, and Sveta has time for her personal life. Andrei appears in Sveta's life, helping her with her business, her son, and inviting her on dates. But Sveta has no idea that he is her main competitor, the owner of a chain of bakeries, who lures away her clients, which deals a big blow to Sveta's business.
title: Забытый рецепт любви

overview: Theater director Nika Subbotina returns to her hometown on the anniversary of her father's death and discovers that the house now belongs to a new owner - her father's former business partner took over his company and married her mother. Nika gradually faces problems in her family, including a conflict with her new stepfather and the disappearance of her younger sister. Moreover, an old family friend suspects that Edward may be involved in the tragedy. In order to understand what is happening, Nika gets a job at a local cultural center and, with the help of former journalist Philip Avdeev, begins her own investigation...
title: Новый муж нашей мамы

overview: The first talk show in Russia where problems are not just talked about - they are solved directly on the air. Those who are desperate to cope with their endless failures and protracted conflicts come to the studio. Professionals come to their aid: psychologists, psychotherapists, nutritionists, philanthropists. The stories discussed in the studio will not leave anyone indifferent - after all, anyone can encounter them.
title: Кадони шоу

overview: Svetlana is a famous rehabilitation doctor. One day she witnesses the death of her close friend Denis, partially loses her memory and decides to flee the city in order to think over everything and understand what to do next. Meanwhile, an influential businessman, the father of the murdered man, Alexander Garin, is hot on her heels, and he manages to track down and kidnap Sveta. But fortunately, she has a person who is ready to save her.
title: На реке

overview: Anna Polonskaya gave up her career and devoted all her time and attention to her family - her daughter Polina and her husband Vlad. One day Anna finds out that Vlad has taken a mistress, and in order not to divide property during a divorce, he transferred everything to his brother, and began to threaten Anna that he would take away his daughter. Anna is forced to fight for her daughter and urgently look for work. After unsuccessful attempts to find a job, Anya accepts an unusual offer from businessman Yuri - to portray his bride in front of her mother on weekends. After a dramatic divorce, Yuri does not want a serious relationship, but his mother persuades him to get married. Soon Anya realizes that she is starting to fall in love with Yuri, but their contract contains a clause that if feelings appear, they immediately break the contract...
title: Субботняя жена

overview: Lyudmila's husband Vitaly was hospitalized after an accident. Businessman Andrei, feeling guilty for the accident, pays for treatment and offers Lyudmila a job in his company. Soon Lyudmila realizes that she has fallen in love with Andrei... This scares her, she cannot betray her husband! Vitaly comes to his senses, and Lyudmila finds out that her husband had been cheating on her for a long time and was going to get a divorce... And Andrey's fiancee tells Lyudmila that it was he who was to blame for the accident. Lyudmila realizes with horror that Andrei has been lying to her all this time and bought her "loyalty" with money and work in the company. Lyudmila has to go through a difficult path to believe in the sincerity of a loving man and become happy.
title: По воле случая

overview: This is an Indian show hosted by a well-known Indian film-maker, Karan Johar. The guests that he interviews are usually popular celebrities from Bollywood.
title: Koffee With Karan

overview: Because of her cuckoo mother, who is infatuated with another man, young Katya ends up on the street and is forced to take care of herself. Following her dream, she enters an aviation technical school to study to become a flight attendant, but her plans are ruined by a meeting with Alexei, from whom she became pregnant. Having given birth to a girl, she was left absolutely alone without help or support. Realizing that a child is an unbearable burden for her, Katya is forced to give up her daughter. It would seem that everything is getting better - Katya continues her studies and becomes a flight attendant. But as a result of an absurd accident, she ends up in a colony for 10 years... All these years she thinks only about her daughter - she is tormented by her conscience that she left her child. Upon release, Katya finds her daughter's adoptive parents and learns that she has died...
title: Кукушки

overview: Mila Koroleva decides to leave the capital and go to a small provincial town to start a new life there. But will she be able to get rid of the secret pursuer following on her heels? Moreover, he is already ready to move from threats to action. Ksenia Koroleva, having learned about the danger looming over her daughter, comes to her to help find the criminal and protect Mila.
title: Тайна города М.

overview: Natalya devoted herself to caring for her beloved husband Andrei. But suddenly Natalya finds out about the betrayal. Her marriage collapses overnight, and Natalya is forced to leave home. Now she needs to look not only for housing, but also for work. One after another, attempts fail. In desperation, the heroine decides to get a job as a live-in nurse. Professional violinist Dmitry wants to provide round-the-clock care for his father Boris Evgenievich. But everything is not so simple: the sick father is categorically against the nurse and agrees to accept help only from close people. However, Dima has thought through everything: he is preparing a performance in which Natalya will play the main role.
title: Нужна невеста с проживанием

overview: In the capital, Qin Chonglou, the head of Qin Cottage, a medicine shop, and General Yun Zilong simultaneously requested the emperor to marry the daughter of the Mo family medical clinic. However, the Mo family has two legitimate daughters, Mo Jingyu and concubine Mo Banxia, and the emperor They were ordered to draw lucky bags to get married: whoever was drawn would get married.
title: Wife Above All

overview: Disasterina, star of Sado Psychiatrist and The Boulet Brothers' Dragula, interviews a variety of drag artists to showcase the different styles of drag in performance, looks, and personalities. From seasoned underground fan favorites to the lesser known newbies, Disasterina and her talented guests prove that ALL drag is valid.
title: Disasterina's My Drag Is Valid

overview: The true story of a group of American teens who embarked on a coast-to-coast bike trip in the summer of 1982 to raise money for multiple sclerosis. The riders are transformed on this journey of a lifetime as they experience intense challenges, humor, mishaps, personal discovery and tragedy.
title: Shadow of a Wheel
